scripts.reinstall-push: npm cache clean --force && rm -rf node_modules/bluedot-react-native-pushnotifications && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const l=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package-lock.json','utf8'));if(l.packages&&l.packages['node_modules/bluedot-react-native-pushnotifications'])delete l.packages['node_modules/bluedot-react-native-pushnotifications'].integrity;fs.writeFileSync('package-lock.json',JSON.stringify(l,null,2)+'\n');" && npm install
